P.name: The Relentless Storm
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Volibear''' damages at least one enemy with a {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}}, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''The Relentless Storm'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage and stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, '''Volibear''' gains ''Lightning Claws''.
P.description2: {{sbc|The Relentless Storm:}} For each stack, '''Volibear''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|5%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to {{as|25%|attack speed}} {{as|(+ 15% per 100 AP)}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Lightning Claws:}} '''Volibear's''' claws ignite with lightning, empowering his basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} to deal {{as|{{pp|10+1*x for 3; then + 2*x for 3; then + 3*x for 7; then + 4*x for 7|formula=10+1 per level until lvl 3, then+2 until lvl 6, then+3 per level until lvl 13, then+4 per level}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}} '''bonus''' magic damage|magic damage}} to the target and the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 450 units of the target, chaining up to 4 subsequent targets.

Q.name: Thundering Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' drops on all fours, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 4 seconds, doubled while facing a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12 to 26}}%|Increased Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|12*2 to 26*2}}%}}
Q.description2: During this time, '''Volibear's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} has a modified {{tip|attack windup|windup}} time and is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}, and {{tt|{{tip|dash|pounce}} on the target|to 25 to 150 units closer than attack range, if Volibear is not closer already}}, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. This damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
Q.description3: If '''Volibear''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} by an enemy during ''Thundering Smash'', the effect ends prematurely and the {{sti|cooldown}} is reset.
Q.description4: ''Thundering Smash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Volibear's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Frenzied Maul
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' slashes the target enemy with his claws to deal {{as|physical damage}}, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and mark the target ''Wounded'' for 8 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 105}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 6% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Wounded Bonus:}} If the target is already ''Wounded'', '''Volibear''' takes a bite out of them instead, dealing {{ccs|50% {{as|(+ 25% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} increased damage|physical}} and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself. The heal is halved against {{tip|minions}}.
W.leveling2: {{st|Heal|{{ap|20 to 80}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8 to 20}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}|Minion Heal|{{ap|20*0.5 to 80*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8*0.5 to 20*0.5}}% of his '''missing''' health)}}}}

E.name: Sky Splitter
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' summons a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after a 2-second delay, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after the first second of the delay. If '''Volibear''' is within the strike, he gains a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|14% of his '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}} for 3 seconds.
E.description2: The bolt deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, capped against non-{{tip|champions}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 200}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|11 to 15}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Non-Champion Capped Damage|{{ap|150 to 610}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

R.name: Stormbringer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Volibear''' gains ''Stormbringer'' for 12 seconds and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over 1 second, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area in a 500 radius during the travel.
R.description2: {{sbc|Stormbringer:}} '''Volibear''' gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{as|{{sti|50 '''bonus''' attack range}}}}, 25 increased range on ''{{ai|Frenzied Maul|Volibear}}'', and 35% increased {{tip|size}}.
R.description3: '''Volibear''' {{tt|impacts|centered on Volibear's location when the dash ends in any way}} after 1 second, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by 50% decaying over 1 second. Enemies within the epicenter are also dealt {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}.
R.description4: '''Volibear''' also disables enemy {{tip|turrets}} in an area for a duration, rendering them unable to attack, as well as dealing them the {{ccs|same damage|physical}}.
R.description5: ''{{ais|Thundering Smash|Volibear}} duration will be paused for the {{tip|dash|leap}}.''
